description.narrative: The project aims to improve the efficiency of Uzbekistan's railway operations, combining investments where it faces operational bottlenecks (e.g. electric locomotives), and strategic support to improve business practices.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3785: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 05 Jul 2024

Progress Toward Outcome: The loan became effective on 23 September 2019. Contract for PIU-05 was awarded and signed on 17 July 2019 through advance contracting. The electric locomotives are currently being produced as scheduled. The first batch of locomotives were received in Uzbekistan in Quarter 4 of 2020.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Sep 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51052/51052-002-apfs-en_2.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Output 1 (Electric locomotives commissioned): On track to being achieved. Contract have been signed on 17 July 2019.Additional 6 freight electric locomotives and spare parts were procured through Supplementary Agreement No. 1 which was signed on 16 April 2020. 17 locomotives out of 30 were received by October 2021. Achievements will be assessed upon completion.Output 2 (Locomotive depot upgraded): On track to being achieved. Achievements will be assessed upon completion.Output 3 (Long-term development strategy implemented): On track to being achieved. On long-term development strategy, a coordination agreement has been signed in May 2020 between UTY, ADB and DBEC. A working group is meeting every week. On gender action plan, trainings/meetings delayed due to COVID-19, and to be resumed immediately after the situation allows.
Achievements will be assessed upon completion.
